names: Province of British Columbia — Ministry of Forests (stumpage)
period: an invoice for each scale return and a Statement of Account every month: “Statements of Account are issued on the 23rd of each month and mailed to your main location address.”
delivery: an invoice, then a Billing Notice by mail: “Billing Notices are issued one day after invoices are sent and show details about the items on your invoices. Notices are mailed to your main location address.”
payment: through a bank or financial institution (EFT, wire), online with eTaxBC, or by cheque to the Minister of Finance; no card: “Through your bank or financial institution” … “EFTs and wire transfers can take up to three days to get from your bank to us.” … “Credit card payments are not accepted.”
terms: “Your stumpage and export fees are due upon receipt of your invoice.”
unpaid: “Interest applies to all overdue accounts at a rate of prime plus 3%.”
remit_to: “Collection Loan Management Group Ministry of Finance PO Box 9990 Stn Prov Govt Victoria BC V8W 9R7”
